documents.title: Guidelines on using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) for Coursework
documents.summary: Undergraduate (AB) coursework policy from the Office of the Provost. GenAI may not be used for submitted coursework unless expressly permitted, so it is disallowed by default; instructors decide per course and are encouraged to say so in the syllabus. Any permitted use must be acknowledged under the Academic Honor Policy, and students who are unsure must ask. Sample acknowledgment statements are included.
documents.stance_why: The policy says "Students may not use GenAI tools for submitted coursework unless expressly permitted" and that "GenAI tools are disallowed by default in courses". Instructors may allow or disallow, but the policy itself sets the default ban and offers no tiers or templates, so AI is banned unless permitted: restrict rather than delegates. Coder A coded delegates because the decision is handed to instructors; coder B coded restrict. Re-reading the text, the default ban is the document's own stance and the delegation only lifts it course by course.
